content: Irhegeko liyêrekîre abajà
Alaga irhegeko wabahà:
Amango okagula omujà Muyahudi, anakukolera myâka ndarhu, ogwa kali nda, analîkwe, buzira kujuha cici.
Akabà àyishaga yênene, anagenda yênene. Akabà àgwêrhe omukazi, mukâge anagenda bo naye.
Akabà nnawâbo wamuhâga omukazi, n’akabà nyamukazi àmuburhîre abânarhabana erhi abâna-nyere, omukazi n’abâna banabè ba nnawâbo, naye anagenda yênene.
Ci erhi oyo mujà ankaderha, erhi: «Nsîmire nnawîrhu, mukânie n’abâna bâni ntalonzizi kulîkwa»,
nnawâbo anamuhêka embere za Nyamuzinda, amuhise aha lumvi erhi oku mulirango: nnawâbo anamurhuliraho okurhwiri n’omugera: anabà mujà wâge ensiku zoshi.
Erhi omuntu ankaguza omwâli burhumisi-kazi, yêhe arhankalîkwa kula abajà balîkwa.
Erhi ankabà arhasimisizi nnâhamwâbo walicimwishozire, nnâhamwâbo anayêmêra agombôlwe. Ci arhankamuguliza ishanja ly’ihanga, bulya okwo kwanabà nka kulenganya.
Erhi omugala ankabà y’amuhà, anamujirire nk’oku banakômerera okujirira abandi banyere.
Erhi ankamuhirakwo owundi, amanye arhamunyihizagya ebiryo, erhi emyambalo, erhi eby’obuyumpa.
Akabà arhamuhiri ebyo oku binali bisharhu, anacîgendera busha, buzira kujuha igerha.
Amabî galînganîne olufù
Owâshûrhe omuntu kuhika okufà, naye anayirhwe, afè.
Ci erhi akabà arhâli alâlîre okumuyîrha, bulya Nyamuzinda walilonzize okumuhira omu maboko gâge, nanamuyêreka aha akwânîne okuyâkira.
Ci omuntu walâlira okuyîrha owâbo n’obwenge, onamurhenze ciru n’aha luhêrero lwâni, agendinigwa, afè!
Owashûrhe îshe erhi nnina, ananigwe, afè.
Owâbakule omuntu, ajimuguza erhi amugwârhe omu mwâge, oyo naye ananigwe, afè.
Owahehêrere îshe erhi nnina, ananigwe, afè.
Empîmbo n’ebibande
Abantu erhi bankalôngôla, muguma akashûrha owâbo, amuyagaze n’ibuye erhi n’ecifundo, olya wâbo akabà arhafîri, ci agend’ijà aha ncingo,
akahash’ishubizûka n’okuhika embuga ajà agendera oku kakoma, nyakushûrha erhi amalufuma; ci analyula erya miregerege agezize aha ncingo n’okumubukîsa kuhika afume.
Erhi omuntu ankashûrha omujà erhi omujà-kazi wâge n’akarhi, bakanafira omu maboko gâge, nyakufà anacihôlerwa.
Ci erhi bankahembûka, enyuma lya lusiku luguma, erhi ibirhi, barhankacicîholerwa, bulya bali birugu byâge.
Erhi bantu babirhi bankagwârhana balwa, bakahukula omukazi oli izîmi, nyamukazi akamoma, ciru akabà arhafîri, barhegesirwe balyûle nk’olu îba wa nyamukazi anahûnyire, n’oku batwirîrwe n’abacîranuzi.
Ci erhi ankafà, bajuhe obuzîne oku buzîne
isù oku isù, lîno oku lîno, kuboko oku kuboko, kugulu oku kugulu,
obuhye oku buhye, ecihulu oku cihulu.
Erhi omuntu ankashûrha isù ly’omujà erhi lya mujà-kazi wâge, akanalisherêza, anabalîke bacîgendere, kubè kubajuha lirya isù lyâbo.
N’akabà lyàli lîno lya mujà wâge erhi lya mujà-kazi wâge, akûzire, anabalike bacîgendere, kubè kubajuha lirya lîno lyâbo.
Erhi empanzi yankatumirha omuntu, abè mulume erhi mukazi, enamuyîrha, eyo mpanzi enabândwe amabuye, n’enyama yayo erhalîbagwa, ci nn’enkâfu yêhe arhalikwo lubanja.

Ci eyo mpanzi erhi yankaba yàkômereraga okutumirhana na nnayo bakazimurhonda, ci yêhe arhashibiriraga okuyilanga, n’erhi yankayîrha omuntu, abè mulume erhi mukazi, eyo mpanzi nayo enabandwe amabuye, na nnayo naye, anayirhwe.
Erhi bankamutwîr’okujuha, anahana birya banamutwirire byoshi omu kugombôla obuzîne bwâge.
Erhi ankabà mwâna-rhabana erhi mwâna-nyere, okwo eryo irhegeko lidesire ko yankanatwirwa.
Erhi empanzi yankatumirha omujà mulume erhi mukazi, nnawâbo empanzi analyule nnâhamwâbo balya bajà mafûndo asharhu ga magerha, n’erya mpanzi enabândwe amabuye.
Erhi omuntu ankaleka iriba buzira kulibwikira, nîsi erhi ahumbe iriba buzira kulibwikira, empanzi kandi erhi endogomi yankarhogeramwo,
nnalirya iriba ahônge, alyûle nna-cirya cîntu ensaranga, n’ecîntu cifìre aciyôrhane.
Erhi empanzi y’omuntu yankatumirhana n’ey’omulungu, ekanafà, banaguze empanzi ecizîne, bagabâne ensaranga; n’erya efîre nayo banayigabâna.
Akabà kwàli kumanyikîne oku eyo mpanzi ekômerera okutumirhana, na nnayo arhashîbirira okuyilanga anahônge eyindi mpanzi ahâli h’empanzi, n’erya efîre yanabà yâge.
Obushambo bw’ebintu
Erhi omuntu ankazimba empanzi erhi cibuzi, abibâge erhi abiguze, anahônga nkâfu irhanu ahâli h’erya nguma, na bibuzi binni ahâli ha cirya ciguma.
